english.title: Provide air traffic control service other than in compliance with terms of air traffic control approval
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person in charge of the provision of an air traffic control service, namely **(..SPECIFY SERVICE..), provided such a service for United Kingdom airspace or airspace outside the United Kingdom for which the United Kingdom had, under international arrangements, undertaken to provide air navigation services when you had not

(A)_[been given]_
(B)_[complied with the terms, namely **(..SPECIFY TERMS..), of]_

an air traffic control approval granted by the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 180(1) and 265(7) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
